headline: Foreign Investors Net Sell for 4 Straight Days, Withdrawing Nearly NT$150 Billion! NT Dollar Falls 3 Days in a Row; Battle to Defend 32 Begins
summary: Foreign investors have net sold for four straight days, withdrawing nearly NT$150 billion. The New Taiwan dollar closed at 31.895 per US dollar on the 12th, its third consecutive daily decline.
why: The New Taiwan dollar and Taiwan's equity market are sensitive to foreign portfolio flows, given the large role of foreign investors and the island's chip exporters. Currency moves affect exporters and import costs.

impacts.name: New Taiwan dollar
impacts.why: The input reports the NT dollar closed lower against the US dollar for three consecutive sessions.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
